Jobs.Name: Machinist
Jobs.Description: Manipulates drones for offense and support, strong effects but requires a lot of MP.

Jobs.Name: Brawler
Jobs.Description: Unarmed fighter with great physical prowess. Its various combos can disable an enemy in various ways.

Jobs.Name: Freelancer
Jobs.Description: A true adventurer at heart, has developed skills on various fields. Can usually adapt to any situation and keep a lighthearted attitude.

Jobs.Name: Magical Girl
Jobs.Description: Supports your team and destroys your enemies while being flashy and cute. Not a regular Mage.

Jobs.Name: Trickster
Jobs.Description: Expert at drawing attention and dodging attacks. Can use many stage effects with varied effects.

Jobs.Name: Witch
Jobs.Description: A magic user that focuses on sleep, for both offense and support.

Abilities.Name: Stun Gun
Abilities.Description: Can't rely on just drones.

Abilities.Name: Nuclear Order
Abilities.Description: Any sufficiently advanced technology is indistinguishable from magic.

Abilities.Name: Nanomachines
Abilities.Description: Will work even if the target would die.

Abilities.Name: Orbital Laser
Abilities.Description: Applies "Burn" and "Shocked" for 4 turns. Will apply "MP Leak" to self for the same duration.

Abilities.Name: (EX) Shatter
Abilities.Description:
Applies 4 turns of Armor Down and Resist Down, but consumes Vulnerable.
Consumes Heat and Extreme Heat, gain Awakening for 4 turns.

Abilities.Name: (EX) Head Smash
Abilities.Description:
Applies a turn of Stop, but consumes Vulnerable.
Consumes Heat and Extreme Heat, gain Awakening for 4 turns.

Abilities.Name: (EX) Flying Press
Abilities.Description:
Consumes Vulnerable if the target has it.
Consumes Heat and Extreme Heat, gain Awakening for 4 turns.

Abilities.Description: Consumes Heat and Extreme Heat, gain Awakening for 4 turns.

Abilities.Name: Grapple
Abilities.Description: Quick combo starter. Must be calm to use.

Abilities.Description:
Applies a turn of Silence and 3 turns of Magic Down, but consumes Vulnerable.
Consumes Heat and Extreme Heat, gain Awakening for 4 turns.

Abilities.Description: Consumes Heat and Extreme Heat, gain Awakening for 4 turns.

Passives.Name: Tech Mastery
Passives.Description: Slightly Reduces MP upkeep on "Order" skills. Enables "Scan Goggles", "Orbital Laser" and "Nanomachines".

Passives.Name: Stance Fighter
Passives.Description: Allows unarmed combat and access to the Brawler's unique stances. Begin combat with Brawler Stance active.

Passives.Description: Automatically fires at the enemy team every other turn, lowering their evasion.

Passives.Name: Cute Charm

Passives.Description: With mastery over basic adventuring skills, you can now more easily learn new ones.

Equipment.Description: You can't seem to see anything reflected in it.

Statuses.Name: Enhanced
Statuses.Description: Damage dealt increases by 15%, damage taken decreases by 15% as well.

Statuses.Name: Rush Stance
Statuses.Description:
Accuracy and Evasion +25.
Can't miss above 80%.
Deal 20% less damage.
Turns arrive 15% faster.
Replace Attack with Rush Combo.
Can't use magic.

Statuses.Name: Beast Stance
Statuses.Description:
Deal 15% more physical damage, and take 15% less.
Cannot Crit or Evade, but gain Crit Immunity.
Threat doesn't decay, and gain increases by 50%.
Turns arrive 15% slower.
Replace attack with Beast Combo. Can't use magic.
